name: Create Regional Hostname
description: Create Regional Hostname Create a new Regional Hostname entry. POST /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/addressing/regional_hostnames
context:
POST /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/addressing/regional_hostnames
Create a new Regional Hostname entry. Cloudflare will only use data centers that are physically located within the chosen region to decrypt and service HTTPS traffic. Learn more about [Regional Services](https://developers.cloudflare.com/data-localization/regional-services/get-started/).
Required: zone_id (path)
Optional: body (body)

name: Delete Regional Hostname

name: Fetch Regional Hostname
description: Fetch Regional Hostname Fetch the configuration for a specific Regional Hostname, within a zone. GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/addressing/regional_hostnames/{hostname}

name: Update Regional Hostname
description: Update Regional Hostname Update the configuration for a specific Regional Hostname. PATCH /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/addressing/regional_hostnames/{hostname}
context:
PATCH /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/addressing/regional_hostnames/{hostname}
Update the configuration for a specific Regional Hostname. Only the region_key of a hostname is mutable.

Optional: body (body)
